object: Label of four lines over the priest, sculptured and painted shrine wall (composite text of 77 b and 78)
site: Gebel Barkal, pyramid 15 (Lepsius; the only inscribed pyramid, northern group): 78 on the S.W. wall of the shrine, 77 b on the N.E. wall
notes: Griffith prints ONE composite text: 77 b (N.E. wall, much injured, 23 x 8 cm; L., D. VI, Bl. 7, no. 27) and 78 (S.W. wall, nearly complete, 25 x 10 cm; Cailliaud no. 2, Lepsius no. 26): 'The two together give the following, in archaic writing.' This row stands for both; the no. 77 queen's name, a cartouche in Meroitic hieroglyphic type ('N[-]zamak'), has its own 0077 row. Griffith's rendering: 'Yetaretey, wize of Pakartar, shatamazes, qêrapas, and panqês' (the first word is compared with Meroë 10/5, which has an initial y). He prints '?' over the divider between pkrtrl and widelo, and over the final l of pkrtrl: 'the final letter must be either l or t'; the group agrees with the royal name Pakartar (Meroë, Pyr. A 16). The squeeze of 77 shows traces of a first line, of which there was more in Cailliaud's copy; Lepsius's copy ignores it but adds strokes below the last line, which seem accidental.
